action: Introduces the armature as a skeleton: bones placed where real joints are, the character then connected to it.
why: Narration: think of it as a skeleton for your character.

action: Uses Rigify, the built-in add-on, rather than hand-built bones; the human metarig is fitted from the side, then hips and thighs, then each finger bone inside the hand.
view: side full body; close-ups of hips and hand
why: Narration: use a premade one in Blender called Rigify and modify it to suit your character.
reader_equivalent: fit_metarig and the finger fix (stage 10 steps 3 to 5).

action: Says a rig for animation needs much more cleanup than one for posing, and that this character is rigged for posing only.
why: Narration: you will still need to do a lot of cleanup especially if you plan to animate as opposed to just posing.
reader_equivalent: rig-for-animation.md exists because of this warning.

action: Binds the character, bends an arm and raises both arms to a T to look for bad deformations; coloured IK/FK arm controls and finger controls visible.
view: front, close-up of the arm and hand
why: Narration: I'll move her around a bit and do some corrections to any bad deformations before committing to a final pose.

action: Makes a test pose, then pushes it to a closed-fist fighter stance.
view: front full body; close-up of a fist
why: Narration: I want to go for a closed fist fighter look.
reader_equivalent: Stage 10 step 14 for a still; for animation, key it and stash it (rig-for-animation step 5).

action: Lists the pose fixes to sculpt: hair moved by the pose, skin compressing and stretching in a fist, the pelvis twisted.
why: Narration: sculpt in any changes that happen from that pose.
reader_equivalent: posed_copy, then corrective_from_posed and drive_by_angle (rig-for-animation step 3).

action: Bent arm: makes the olecranon prominent; notes the forearm twist from pronation and supination.
why: Narration: the olecranon at the upper end of the ulna becomes more prominent and visible.
reader_equivalent: elbow_bend.L key; forearm twist check with pose_report (rig-for-animation step 3).

action: Inflates the finger sections and knuckles of the fist, looking at his own hand.
why: Narration: compressions, stretching, bony prominences such as the knuckles that you will get as a fist.
reader_equivalent: fist.L key driven by ORG-hand.L and ORG-f_middle.02.L.

action: Reworks the hair for the tilted head and gravity; fixes the shoelaces that deformed badly when the shoes tilted up.
why: Narration: simply tilting her shoes upwards messed around a lot with the shoelaces area.
reader_equivalent: Scalp bound to the head; laces rigid on DEF-foot.L/R or on the boot helper.

action: Switches to Multires for the final detail pass on the posed, retopologized mesh.
why: Narration: I will now sculpt using the multi resolution modifier as opposed to dynamic topology.
reader_equivalent: Not for an animated character: detail goes on the rest mesh (stage 09 bake), pose changes into driven keys.

action: Says the armature is applied after posing, so symmetry is gone and both sides are sculpted separately.
why: Narration: since I already posed her and applied the armature I don't have any symmetry to work with anymore.
reader_equivalent: Never apply the armature for animation (rig-for-animation step 1); one key per side.
